name: Super Robot Taisen Z
comment: Per-game config for the investigation tools (tools\wall.ps1, run-game.ps1, run-report.ps1). Paths are relative to the MAIN checkout. Checkpoint ticks are guest VBlank counts (~60/s) in OUR port, not PCSX2 frames. Boot timing drifts by up to ~600 ticks between runs (run43/wallrun2 vs wallrun1/wallcal1, same build), so dump windows are wide and the reference comparison picks the best frame.

build.comment: {root} = main checkout, {key} = paths.<key>. 'recomp' steps run with -Recomp, 'build' steps with -Build; 'clean' is deleted first. build-game.bat holds the shared build lock.

fastforward.comment: A fixed factor, not max: at max busy host time is charged at the busy scale, VBlank counts run ahead of the content (SRWZ title at VBlank 32k-46k instead of ~27k) and the tick-based dump windows miss their checkpoint.

pad.comment: Pad macros and routes for tools/route.py (-Route on long-run.ps1 / wall.ps1, --route on fpsrun.py; checkpoints may name a route). Steps: BUTTON[|BUTTON][+hold], 'wait N' (ticks after the previous press), 'at N' (absolute VBlank tick), <macro/route>, <step>*N. Presses with no wait between them are 'gap' ticks apart. More routes as files: config/routes/<name>.txt, one step per line, '#' comments ('# unverified' marks one). Buttons: o = CIRCLE confirms, x = CROSS goes back (SELECT SCENARIO header).

skip_movie.notes: START at 3000 skips the opening movie straight to the title menu (START/LOAD/CONTINUE/LIBRARY at 3060; t2padon). Earliest tried; the movie starts ~2820-3060.

next_line.notes: o 400 ticks after the previous press: advances a text crawl or one dialogue line (a line prints in well under 400 ticks at 1x)
